1/ Cash Flow Brief, Nov 10 ☀️

The 8:30 AM CPI inflation report is the biggest thing for your wallet today.

What happened, why it matters, and what could happen next 🧵

2/ Politics: Trump told CNN an Iran strike is "highly unlikely" if talks progress and a strong deal is signed.

Why it matters: oil and Gulf shipping risk feed into fuel prices.

Next: if talks stall, oil risk could rise again.

3/ Economy: October CPI hits at 8:30 AM today. Forecast 0.3% m/m, core 0.2%.

Why it matters: a hot print can push rate hopes up, raising mortgage and card costs.

Next: if inflation runs hot, December hike talk grows. Watch yields and the dollar.

4/ Stocks: Friday, Nvidia fell 8.8% on the week and Oklo jumped 22.7%. Thursday's S&P 500 drop was 4.4%.

Why it matters: sharp swings like this can hit 401(k)s fast.

Next: if CoreWeave's report today disappoints, the chip rebound may fade.

5/ Crypto: Bitcoin is near $74K, Fear and Greed at 32. ETFs saw $1.177B net outflows last week.

Why it matters: weak ETF demand means less buying support.

Next: if CPI runs hot, pressure may persist.

Not financial advice.

video.script: Inflation day is here, and it could touch your mortgage and savings. At 8:30 AM Eastern, the October CPI report lands. Forecast: 0.3% monthly headline, down from 0.6%. Core is forecast at 0.2%. If it runs hot, rate-hike talk for December grows, and borrowing costs could stay high. If it cools, yields and the dollar may ease. Overseas, Trump says a strike on Iran is highly unlikely if talks progress, and Russia-Ukraine talks start today in Abu Dhabi. Oil and gas prices can react to both. Bitcoin is near 74K, and spot Bitcoin ETFs saw 1.177 billion dollars in outflows last week. Not financial advice. Follow for tomorrow's brief.
